actual_original_B4.return_scope: Original token_level_rewards.sum(-1), same row score as official GRPO; Q_zero is separately selected from actual saved dt_q_estimates.
actual_original_B4.conditional_scope: Conditional subset statistics use that subset's count only for descriptive successful-token amplitude; they never replace the original loss denominator.
actual_original_B4.same_policy_scope: Original core policy loss called with saved old_log_probs for both old and current, deliberately setting ratio=1. No current logits reconstructed. Saved native PPO KL/clipfrac are reported separately; mean PPO KL=0 alone does not prove every historical/native token ratio is1.
actual_original_B4.statistics_dtype: Original owner scalar reductions remain FP32; conditional descriptive masses/moments use temporary FP64 reductions only.

coefficient_source_account.scope: Arithmetic mean of two recorded rank scalar summaries;16 equally weighted B4, not global pooled token mean or gradient norm.
coefficient_source_account.meaning: Descriptive coefficient identities using the exact original B4 denominators. Conditional quantities divide pooled original-denominator subset masses by the correspondingly weighted support fraction; they are not unweighted means of per-B4 conditional means, a proposed normalization, or causal gradient shares.

gradient_account.scope: Pre-clip complete local32 minibatch gradients from native backward; sharded DTensor scalar statistics SUM on its original mesh; replicated/plain contributions remain local.
limits: The 1/211.33 result is a pre-clip task-gradient norm ratio, not an Adam parameter update ratio or quality ratio.
The per-unit absolute coefficient response is a descriptive quotient, not a per-token Jacobian/cancellation decomposition.
The observed response quotient is 6.85 in favor of DT, so an added gradient-cancellation factor is not supported as the main explanation of the small gradient ratio.
The near-orthogonal task-gradient cosine indicates the two estimates are not a scalar rescaling; it does not establish which is correct.

actual_signature.signature: (token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor, response_mask: torch.Tensor, index: numpy.ndarray, traj_index: numpy.ndarray, epsilon: float = 1e-06, norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: str = True, compute_mean_std_cross_steps: bool = True)

official_GRPO_comparison.support_semantics: Official GRPO centers and standardizes actual prompt-group outcomes, then broadcasts the result through the original action mask; mixed groups give positive G1 and negative G0 coefficients. DT uses the fixed sampled event formula, for which G0 terms are zero.

inverse_d_vs_original_signed_sum.statistics_scope: finite saved values; FP64 descriptive reductions

mapping_scale_check.meaning: The actual expm1 reward composition is near unit response for these small d values; observed small coefficients already exist in the DT d vector rather than being caused by an added composition scale.

formal_original_readout.sampling_scope: 186 unique current responses from 21 successful trajectories in the native64 carrier; not 186 independent trajectories and not the all64 first-response readout.
limits: Whole-response endpoints are not uniformly identical/near zero.
Joint endpoint conservation alone does not establish per-token counterfactual accuracy or identify the cause of the small token amplitudes.
A whole-response versus token average quotient is not an error ratio or a causal attenuation factor.

complete64_first_response_readout.scope: All64 earliest retained active real responses at checkpoint25. Native-v2 layout differs from original paired attribute layout; use for batch descriptive forecasting only.
complete64_first_response_readout.constant_scope: Descriptive fitted-to-this-batch constant, not an out-of-sample predictive model.
complete64_first_response_readout.same_batch_interpretation: High success forecasts and weak success/failure separation are observed. This does not isolate label-vocabulary bias from forecasting quality or prove a specific encoding bug.

encoding_source_checks.binary_label_support: TextCraft uses return classes 0,1, distinct single-token IDs15,16; scores use original categorical head over these two labels, not full-vocabulary token probabilities.
encoding_source_checks.target_averaging: Exactly one observed-label target per response and one offset0; PackedAnswerTargets sample_sums sums. No target-token average is applied.
encoding_source_checks.discount_and_return: Official gamma1; reverse cumulative reward with each successful current response G1. No exponential reward decay or reward-unit attenuation in this batch.
encoding_source_checks.prefix_encoding: Exact original prompt/action token IDs retained; query and target equal across endpoints, only current source response changed to EOS. Target is excluded from its predictor prefix; no sampled future O/action/reward/stop-time enters the query.

query_format_facts.construction: Frozen RewardAlphabet.query_ids 132-146 directly encodes explicit Qwen message control tokens with add_special_tokens=False, then _prepare_episode appends those original query IDs. It does not invoke apply_chat_template a second time.

query_format_facts.predictor_state: The label predictor follows the new assistant message and a closed empty think block. The prior current response belongs to the preceding assistant role; 38/64 contain one think opener and no think closer, 26/64 contain both. Its stored final im_end is followed by the query initial im_end in all 64, and in all 186 formal requests.
query_format_facts.contract_boundary: Explicit role delimiters are part of the frozen readout owner contract. The saved double im_end and unfinished prior reasoning are measured formatting facts; there is no corresponding owner assertion or matched alternate-score evidence here proving them defective or causal. No template or token changes are proposed.

encoding_source_checks.limits: One fixed label mapping/query has no matched alternate-score evidence proving that its role boundaries or 0/1 lexical preference cause small token d. No template change is proposed.

established: The native task gradient is small in the actual official loss because its unscaled token coefficients are small and only the observed G1 support is nonzero, whereas GRPO has O(1) group-standardized coefficients on both G1 and G0.
Both methods use the same original B4 token mean/accumulation; no DT-only extra B4 or length division was found.
Official PPO clipping was inactive in all16 recorded B4 for this diagnostic; no alternate clipping explains this ratio.
Actual readout output is overoptimistic and weakly separates this batch outcomes.
Reward-to-advantage composition is not introducing the approximately200-fold amplitude gap.
unknown: The share of the small d magnitude attributable to joint finite allocation, forecasting quality, token interactions, or native low-precision storage is not identified by this complete64 coefficient accounting.
Small selected single-deletion probes cannot establish all-token or whole-training quality.
No per-token/B4 gradient Gram is saved to allocate gradient cancellation or sensitivity causally.
Actual original-Adam update/entropy drift must be measured with original optimizer states; the present gradient ratios are not update ratios.
No supported replacement/repair to query, scaling or fixed Q/V/A is established by this audit.
